graph_meta.problem_text: A car travels 90 km in 150 minutes. If it continues at the same speed, what distance will it cover in 4 hours?
graph_meta.description: Solution DAG for the car-distance proportion. It converts 4 hours to 240 minutes, sets up a proportional ratio, and solves by cross multiplication.

nodes.label: Identify the Goal
nodes.description: Identify the quantity or decision the problem asks for.
nodes.prompt: What do we need to find?
hints: State clearly what the question asks you to determine.

nodes.label: Identify Given Information
nodes.description: Identify the facts and quantities provided in this word problem.
nodes.prompt: What information is given in the problem?
accept: a car travels 90 km in 150 minutes and continues for 4 hours
hints: Read the problem carefully and identify the quantities and relationships.

nodes.label: Problem Statement
nodes.description: A car travels 90 km in 150 minutes. Find the distance in 4 hours at the same speed.
nodes.prompt: Convert 4 hours to minutes and set up a correct proportional relation.
hints: The ratio of time and distance should stay the same.
Write a proportion using time and distance.

nodes.label: Final Conclusion
nodes.description: The car will cover 144 km in 4 hours.
nodes.prompt: State the final distance covered in 4 hours.
hints: Cross multiply and solve for x.
x = 144, so the distance is 144 km.

nodes.label: Method 1: Convert time units
nodes.description: Convert 4 hours into 240 minutes so both time values use the same unit.
nodes.prompt: Convert the time to the same unit as in the given ratio.

nodes.label: Convert 4 hours to minutes
nodes.prompt: How many minutes are in 4 hours?

nodes.label: Set up the proportion
nodes.prompt: Write the proportion in the same units.
hints: Use the same units for time in both ratios.
150 minutes to 90 km is the first ratio.
240 minutes to x km is the second ratio.

nodes.label: Method 2: Cross multiplication
nodes.description: Solve the proportion by cross multiplication: 150 × x = 240 × 90.
nodes.prompt: Cross multiply to solve for the unknown distance.

nodes.label: Write the cross product equation
nodes.prompt: What equation do you get after cross multiplication?
hints: Cross multiply the terms of the proportion.

nodes.label: Solve for x
nodes.prompt: Solve the equation to find x.
